integrity: The fixed-Kendall fiber is solved exactly, reducing directional Chatterjee correlation to a one-variable rational function. Its derivative gives the unique minimizer and sharp supremum; a direct subtraction proves the orientation criterion. Exact-rational replay checks the algebra but is not used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the two-parameter Marshall–Olkin copula family.
With the strict parameter restriction 0<alpha,beta<1, the upper Chatterjee endpoint is a supremum rather than an attained maximum.
The result concerns population dependence measures and does not analyze estimation error.
title: A sharp directional-predictability range inside the Marshall–Olkin copula family
